SCHEDULE 2 - SUPPORT AND MAINTENANCE SERVICE LEVELS

This Schedule is entered into between Keystone Analytics Ltd ("Supplier") and Northwind Traders plc ("Customer") and is incorporated into the Services Agreement dated 14 January 2026.

1. SUPPORT HOURS

1.1 Supplier's help desk is staffed Monday to Friday, 09:00 to 17:30 UK time, excluding bank holidays in England and Wales ("Working Hours").

1.2 Severity 1 incidents are supported around the clock. All other severities are handled during Working Hours only.

2. SEVERITY LEVELS AND TARGETS

2.1 Supplier shall meet the following targets for each incident reported by Customer:

Severity 1 - Initial response within 1 hour, 24x7; restoration within 4 hours, 24x7.
Severity 2 - Initial response within 2 working hours; restoration within 2 working days.
Severity 3 - Initial response within 1 working day; resolution within 10 working days.

2.2 Targets for Severity 4 (cosmetic issues and enquiries) are reasonable endeavours only and are not measured.

2.3 Time during which Supplier is waiting on Customer to provide information, or on a third-party vendor to provide a fix, shall be excluded, and the clock shall pause for that period.

3. SERVICE CREDITS

3.1 Where fewer than the target percentage of incidents in a calendar month meet their initial response targets, the following credits apply: if less than 98% of incidents meet the target, 3% of the monthly charges; if less than 95%, 7% of the monthly charges; if less than 90%, 15% of the monthly charges. Total credits shall not exceed 15% of the monthly charges.

3.2 Service credits are a price adjustment reflecting the reduced value of the Services and are not an estimate of loss.

4. REPORTING

4.1 Supplier shall provide Customer with a monthly report showing incident counts by severity and attainment against each target.
